summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, information systems major, works in tech (sysadmin/ops), avid cyclist, enjoys outdoor activities (hiking, mountain biking), critical of corporate practices (especially in media and tech), politically engaged with strong opinions on social issues, skeptical of mainstream media, values privacy and data security, has experience with Linux and open-source software, familiar with Mac and iOS ecosystems, has traveled extensively in Europe, particularly interested in urban planning and public transportation issues, has a critical view of consumerism and corporate greed, engaged in discussions about technology's impact on society.
